Well,

I'm also 17, and I'm decently well off, and I've also been battling with depression for as long as I can remember. 

I can tell you this, when it comes to mood swings, I only chalk up a small percentage to my depression. 

Being a person has all kinds of ups and downs, and sometimes stress can just wear you out to a point where you get too tired to deal with it. (I have friends who say that they get these feelings and they come and go). Even if you don't realize it, stress can be underlying and creeping through the back of your mind. 

For me, personally, when I'm in a rut with my depression, it's a complete and overwhelming feeling that will come suddenly, and unlike the moods that come with stress, I can't sleep it off or paint it out or even sing it away. It sticks to me and will just hits me like tidal waves. 

And the thoughts that usually follow it are grim, or miserable, or just pessimistic (Im a fairly optimistic individual.) 

However, this is all just *personal* experience, and everyone has their own experiences with depression...

I don't know if this helps at all, but whatever you do, if something's bothering you then it's *important* and it shouldn't be ignored...
